clue.text: Races after a line of children showing insincere grief

indicators.note: after places the word for races behind the line of children

parts.note: a crocodile is a British term for schoolchildren walking in a two-by-two line
tears means races, as in rushing along

explanation.surface: A child dashes about after the school line and puts on a show of fake sadness.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a crocodile is a line of schoolchildren walking in pairs. 'after' puts TEARS behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Crocodiles were fabled to weep while eating prey, so the idiom means sorrow that is feigned.

clue.text: Mentioned and put in position, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that a word is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: sited means placed in a position

explanation.surface: Someone was both talked about and placed in a spot.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite something is to refer to or quote it, so a thing cited has been referred to.

clue.text: A drink agreed on a trip

indicators.note: a trip is a stumble, so the preceding letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A beverage was settled upon while out on a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trip' reads as a journey or a drug experience, but it signals that AGREEDONA is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A fizzy soft drink flavoured with citrus fruit.

clue.text: Hunts goals furiously in attacks

indicators.note: furiously suggests wild disorder, so the letters are thrown into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A sporting crowd chases goals fiercely in waves of assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Onslaughts are fierce assaults, the plural matching the plural noun.

clue.text: One new soft material ready for use

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
p (piano) is the musical marking for soft
lace is a delicate fabric

explanation.surface: A single fresh piece of soft fabric is prepared and waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something set in its proper position is arranged and ready to be used.

clue.text: Listener's publicity used to cut sound

parts.note: a listener is an ear, the organ that hears
a plug is a piece of promotion

explanation.surface: Someone's advertising is employed to silence noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopper put in the ear canal blocks out noise; the definition describes its purpose.

clue.text: Reasonable science?

parts.note: the study of reasoning could playfully be called the science that is reasonable

explanation.definitionFit: Logic is the formal study of valid reasoning, a discipline of reason itself.

clue.text: Vegetable in part of ship turned up

indicators.note: turned up in a down answer means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the keel is the ship's bottom structure

explanation.surface: A vegetable appears in a section of a boat that has been flipped over.
explanation.definitionFit: A leek is an onion-family vegetable.

clue.text: Coating left in watch

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for left inside the word for watch

parts.note: to gaze is to look at steadily

explanation.surface: A covering is left in a timepiece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'watch' looks like a timepiece but is the verb, GAZE.
explanation.definitionFit: A glaze is a shiny layer applied to pottery or food.

clue.text: Old measure in Deccan that's changed, abolished

indicators.note: in places the old length inside the rearranged letters
changed signals that the letters of the place name are rearranged

parts.note: an ell is an old unit of cloth length

explanation.surface: An outdated unit used in an Indian region has been scrapped after reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's changed' turns DECCAN into CANCED; 'in' puts ELL inside, after CANC. The Deccan is a plateau in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Cancelled means called off or done away with, the same as scrapped.

clue.text: See 1 across
Ceramic coin Pearl unearthed

indicators.note: unearthed suggests digging up and turning over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An archaeologist digs up a pottery coin and a pearl.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain is fine white china, a kind of fired clay ware.

clue.text: Capable of being destroyed or lowered in worth?

definitions.meaning: able to break down or decompose, as biodegradable material does
able to be degraded, that is reduced in rank or value; the question mark flags the made-up reading

explanation.surface: Something might be wrecked or simply cheapened.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both able to decompose chemically and, read literally, able to be demeaned or reduced.

clue.text: Bazaar held in a cafeteria

indicators.note: held in says the answer is contained within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A charity sale takes place in a canteen.
explanation.definitionFit: A fete is a fundraising fair with stalls, like a bazaar.

clue.text: Sudanese hut not the first being rebuilt, showing excessive speed

indicators.note: being rebuilt says the letters are put together again in a different order
not the first means the opening letter of the nationality is dropped

parts.note: taken as written, from Sudan

explanation.surface: A dwelling in Sudan is being reconstructed in a great rush.
explanation.walkthrough: The page prints 'but', but the letters need 'hut'. 'not the first' drops the S of SUDANESE, and 'being rebuilt' rearranges UDANESE + HUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Haste is speed, and undue means excessive, so the phrase names too much hurry.

clue.text: Noisy argument arising from resistance in a fiddle

indicators.note: in places the electrical symbol inside the word for a fiddle

parts.note: a wangle is a dishonest trick or fiddle
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A loud quarrel breaks out from opposition to a swindle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddle' suggests a violin but means a dodge, WANGLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrangle is a long, heated dispute.

clue.text: Humour? The observer has it rising within

indicators.note: within places the turned word inside the word for an observer

parts.note: a witness is someone who observes an event

indicators.note: rising in a down answer means the word is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Is there comedy in what a bystander sees welling up inside?
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns IT into TI, and 'within' puts it inside WITNESS after WIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Wittiness is cleverness with words, a form of humour.

clue.text: Usual officer in the army

explanation.surface: A typical commander in the military.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means widespread or normal, and is also the title of a senior military commander.

clue.text: Control booth put back in place

parts.note: a rein controls a horse, so to rein is to control
a stall is a small booth at a market

explanation.surface: A regulated market booth is set up again.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstall is to fit or set up again, putting something back where it was.

clue.text: Unusual letters in support

indicators.note: unusual suggests something out of the normal order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Odd correspondence offering backing.
explanation.definitionFit: A trestle is a frame that holds up a table top, a kind of stand.

clue.text: Entrance directions to church worker

parts.note: E and N are compass directions, east and north
a worker ant is the standard crossword worker

explanation.surface: A doorway gives directions to someone employed at a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entrance' looks like a doorway but is the verb, to charm.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone is to captivate or bewitch them.

clue.text: Got involved in Reading and took a course

definitions.meaning: applied oneself to books, poring over them
followed a programme of learning at school or university

explanation.surface: A student became absorbed in the town of Reading and enrolled on a programme.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital R makes Reading look like the English town, but it is plain reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means having read carefully and also having attended classes in a subject.

clue.text: Possibly rings AA, having drink in Spain?

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Could a member phone Alcoholics Anonymous after drinking on a Spanish holiday?
explanation.walkthrough: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous in the surface, but supplies only its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Sangria is a Spanish punch of red wine and fruit.

clue.text: Metal press

definitions.meaning: smooth clothes with a heated appliance

explanation.definitionFit: Iron is a metallic element and also a verb for pressing fabric flat.

clue.text: An attack on TV?

parts.note: a television is a TV set

explanation.surface: Is a broadcast assault being shown on television?
explanation.definitionFit: The onset of something is its start, and an onset is also an assault.

clue.text: A number of sticks go round in this manner for the shrubs

indicators.note: go round says one word surrounds the other

parts.note: canes are sticks, several of them
thus means in this way

explanation.surface: Gather a bundle of sticks and walk around like this to tend the bushes.
explanation.walkthrough: CANES goes round THUS, giving CAN-THUS-ES after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Acanthus is a genus of spiny-leaved plants, so the plural names several of them.

clue.text: Guide the farm animal

definitions.meaning: a young castrated bull raised for beef

explanation.definitionFit: Steer means to direct a course, and a steer is a bullock kept on farms.

clue.text: Inspect in little time off

indicators.note: off means the letter for time is taken away

parts.note: scant means little or barely enough

explanation.surface: Examine things during a brief spell off work.
explanation.definitionFit: To scan is to look over closely or examine.

clue.text: Professorship not difficult to acquire?

parts.note: a university chair that is simple to get, read playfully as a comfortable seat

explanation.definitionFit: An easy chair is a large upholstered armchair; chair also means a professor's post.

clue.text: One's movements are out of this world

definitions.text: One's movements are out of this world

parts.words: One's movements are out of this world
parts.note: out of this world reads as amazing but literally means beyond Earth, where such a voyager goes

explanation.definitionFit: An astronaut journeys beyond Earth, so their travels literally leave this planet.

clue.text: 25 would often be in special material

parts.note: the comfortable seat at 25 across is one that people have sat in

explanation.surface: A comfy seat would often be upholstered in luxurious fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is EASY CHAIR, an armchair; such a chair is often SAT IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Satin is a glossy woven fabric, a fine cloth.

clue.text: See 26
